item.title: Bill for Moda Center renovation funding headed to Gov. Tina Kotek's desk
item.description: The Oregon Senate has passed SB 1501, which will raise over $365 million through bonds to fund major renovations at the Moda Center and ensure a 20-year lease for the Portland Trail Blazers.
